tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge bstan dgra'i srog dbugs len pa'i bshan pa nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag zab mo yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len par 'dod pas/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus yar ngo dang mar ngo'i bcu bzhi gnyis po gang yang rung ba la/ lcags snod du gtor ma zur gsum pa/ zur rnams dang logs la chang bu gzhib pa bdun dang / de'i mtha' mtheb kyu bdun gyis bskor te rgyan pa khrag gam/ ko ma sogs byugs pa'am ma byugs kyang rung ste/ gtor ma dang chang bu rnams mar dang shas rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lag len ltar bshams pa nang mchod chu chang gang rung gis sbyangs la bzhag de nas rang nyid gtor ma de la kha phyogs pas 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed du sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum byas la/ de nas/ rang gi mdun du ma he'i gdan steng du/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbu gsum phyag drug pa/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa pheṃ sgra sgrog /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mche gtsigs spyan gsum ldan/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis gri thod thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi gnyis pas ḍā ma ru yi sgras/ /khro bo'i tshogs kyi dmag dpung bsdud par byed/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis/ /kha ṭwaṃ 'dzin zhing tha ma'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang lpags brgyang zhing drag po'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /de yi g.yas su las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs/ /ma he gyang glang rnga mo khyi lug dang / /lce spyang bong bu'i gdong can rnams gnas shing / /g.yon gyi phyogs su gshin rje'i bya rgod dang / /'ug pa bya rog ne tso khra dang khyung / /srin bya bzhad kyi gdong rnams 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /kun kyang phyag g.yas thod dbyug la sogs pa/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin zhing g.yon pa rnams/

/thod khrag zhags pas sbrel zhing re re 'ang / /rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa 'bum gyis bskor/ /de yi phyi rol bstan srung tshogs rnams dang / /mthu rtsal ldan pa'i lha klu gza' phyogs skyong / /zhing skyong sde brgyad 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs/ /srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po kun gyis bskor/ /sprin dpung 'thib dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar/ /skad cig nyid la mngon sum gsal bar gyur/ /zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas spyan drangs pa ni/ 'dir byon 'dir byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed pa'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi zad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol/ /dgra bgegs rdul du rlag par mdzod/ /ces pas spyan drangs la/ de nas/ khrag gi arghaṃ dbang lnga'i me tog dang / /tshil chen bdug spos zhun chen sgron me dang / /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas dang / /rkang gling rol mo nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis rab rgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab brjid pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod/ /ces mchod cing bstod/ de nas 'di ltar brjod cing bsgom par bya ste/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rin chen las grub ral pa'i gur khang nang / /rang gi srung bya thams cad gsal bar gyur/ /ral pa'i gur las gnam lcags 'khor lo dang / /mtshon cha me phung grangs med rab 'phros pas/ /pha rol srung ma rbad 'dre ma lus pa/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub rbod gtong byed pa po/ /rang la bzlog nas 'joms shing brlag par gyur/ /zhes brjod cing bsam la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang / g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dngul gyi ma stan dang / /mthe bong gser gyi satwa rer bsam/ /g.yas pa'i lcags kyus gnod byed bkug la/ g.yon gyi mthe bong gser gyi satwa gris gtub par bsam la/

oṃ sa bhyoḥbazlog rbadaḥ ci nus bzla/ yang ni rang nyid thub pa sku mdog nag /sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad par gsal bar gyur/ /zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ mu ne mu ne mahā mu ne shākya mu ne ye swāhā/ gsum mam bdun bzlas te/ de nas gong du bsham pa'i gtor ma dang / rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bsgral ba'i gnod byed kyi sha khrag rnams dbyer med du bsam la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pa'i 'phreng ba'i grangs bzung la/ na maḥs manta buddha nan a wa lo ki te sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya phaṭ/ zhes drug cu rtsa bzhi'am/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig gang rung bzlas la/ de'i bar gyi dmigs pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa'i dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la hab thob tu gsol bar bsam mo/ /de nas bden bdar brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlab pa la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rbod gtong rbad 'dre la sogs pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig ces dmod mo drag tu brjod cing thal mo brdab/ de nas ngag tu/ slar yang rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed gsal/ /gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs nas/ bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar brjod la/ de nas yid kyis zor lam phye la/ gong gi gtor ma de nyid dug mtshon du bsam la rbod gtong yod pa'i phyogs su 'phang la/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mar me lta bu thum te bsad par bsam zhing / rdo rje 'jigs byed srung ma 'jig rten dregs pa'i dmag dang bcas pas dmigs yul gtan brlag tu btang zhing /

rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral bar bsam zhing / e sa bhyoḥbazlog rbadaḥmang du bzlas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gsum pa'i ye shes pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ gzhan rnams mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /'di lta bu'i zab mo'i man ngag 'di ni sngags pa phur thogs brgya dang 'gras kyang ya nga mi dgos pa'i man ngag ste/ bsam gtan nyal chog ces kyang bya/ bsad pa las kyi 'khor lo zhes kyang bya/ sngags pa phur thogs gsod pa'i lag cha zhes kyang bya/ yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po zhes kyang bya ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag zab mo kun gyi nang nas 'di kho na la bla ma gong ma rnams thugs rtsis su mdzad pa yin no zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ bla ma gong ma'i snyan ji lta ba bzhin du dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtser sbyar ba 'di la chos bdag mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub bo/ /da dung 'di la man ngag zhal shes cung zad yod pa slob ma snod ldan rnams kyi ngag las btsal bar bya'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal/ padma badzra/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ bla ma rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seṅge/ rwa 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo/ bla ma shes rab seṅge/ mnyan med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dge legs dpal bzang / sngags 'chang a nanda ma ti bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa chos rin chen/ rje dbon brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ bla ma blo gros dpal ldan/ 'dren mchog sangs rgyas mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rgya mtsho/

chos rje lo phu gdan sa pa kun dga' dpal 'byor/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams sogs/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa nam mkha' rgya mtshos/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas 'od zer gnyis las kyang gsan gsungs/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ rwa ye shes seṅge nas/ rwa dharma seṅge/ rwa dkon mchog seṅge/ rwa dben shes rab rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ bla ma brtson 'grus byang chub/ sems dpa' chen po bsod nams yon tan/ chos rje dge legs bzang po man gong dang 'dra'o/ /smras pa/ sems dpa' chen po spyan snga rin chen las/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang dang las gshin gyi/ /rjes gnang gzhan yang zab khrid ma lus pa/ /mtshan ltas bzang po dang bcas dgyes bzhin gnang / /rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog ge bdun pa gsum/ 'grel pa man ngag yig rnying phal cher dang / /mkhas grub chos rin gyis mdzad rnam bshad kyi/ /lung rnams chos rje lo phu ba las nos/ /de phyir phyi ltar sngags 'chang gos dkar 'dzin/ /nang ltar dpal ldan gshin rje ma he'i gdong / /snang srid 'jam dpal khro bo'i rol pa che/ /a la la ho 'di yang bla ma'i drin/ /zhes kyang shugs 'byung du smras pa/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
